scope: N0-N5 initial implementation and small single-machine pilot; no established cross-stage-memory advantage

config.measurement: v2: independent lean C++ process timer, native child wall time and RSS; Python launch/log overhead counted separately
config.compatibility_revision: RC4 excluded for import assertion; MD5 excluded for incorrect default output; sim rejected legacy declaration statements. LLU/trie selected before any neural training; no performance-based replacement.

training.objective: pairwise measured trajectory log latency + relative log latency regression + resource supervision

config.limits: Small single-machine pilot, process-wall timing, fixed Clang O3 backend without LTO/PGO; independent source-output oracle. Do not tune splits, epochs or capacity on test outcomes. Exclude unsupported imports before collecting neural labels and report exclusions; do not silently substitute kernels.

A.objective: pairwise measured trajectory log latency + relative log latency regression + resource supervision
A.selection: minimum validation loss across the prelocked epochs; test family never loaded

B.objective: pairwise measured trajectory log latency + relative log latency regression + resource supervision
B.selection: minimum validation loss across the prelocked epochs; test family never loaded

B_capacity.objective: pairwise measured trajectory log latency + relative log latency regression + resource supervision
B_capacity.selection: minimum validation loss across the prelocked epochs; test family never loaded

current_only.objective: pairwise measured trajectory log latency + relative log latency regression + resource supervision
current_only.selection: minimum validation loss across the prelocked epochs; test family never loaded

limitations: one train family, one validation family, one held-out family; no hardware generalization
five repeats; serial method order; uncontrolled frequency and host load; no confidence interval
trie is a short native process including startup and I/O; ratios are descriptive
current_only and reset ablations retain the shared discrete action-event metadata; continuous neural history is disabled
initial name/type/attribute encoding uses a byte mean and loses order; alignment is mostly function/module anchors after lowering
code_bytes is total object-file size, not text-section bytes; driver/child RSS is process-lifetime peak, not isolated per-model physical memory
pilot-v1 outer-driver timings are retained only for diagnostics and excluded here
post-selection confirmations were collected after the frozen search batch; cumulative active wall and all timed runs are charged; new unified runs confirm immediately
